name: War-Torn Isle -Isekai-
detailed_description:
The protagonist, once an ordinary office worker, dies in a sudden accident and awakens on a mysterious, war-torn island in another world.

In this chaotic and dangerous land, all he possesses are the special skills he has somehow acquired.
Starting a new life as a mercenary, he must use his wits and abilities to survive brutal battlefields.

This is an action RPG with hack-and-slash elements. The field is populated by numerous CPU characters, and large-scale, real-time wars unfold across the island. Players can also enjoy strategic gameplay by reading the ever-changing tides of battle.

A key feature is the reincarnation loop system: each time you die, you are reborn as a new character with new skills, and the story begins anew with familiar tropes.
Defeat is not the end-it fuels your growth. Through repeated cycles of death and rebirth, you will carve your path across countless battlefields and may even influence the fate of the island itself.

Main Features

  • Action RPG with hack-and-slash elements: Fight enemies using a variety of weapons and skills, and enhance your equipment and abilities.

  • Reincarnation loop system: Each death brings a new character with different skills and traits for a fresh challenge.

  • Strategic warfare on a chaotic island: Multiple CPU factions wage real-time war, dynamically shifting the battlefield.

Isekai Reincarnation × Game-
Will you rise to the challenge and defy fate in this harsh otherworld, time and again?
